commitBody:
Raised by Renovate under the policy in renovate.json: dependencies are pinned, npm,
Node and GitHub Action releases are held for three days before they are offered, and
every commit has to install from its own lockfile and pass CI on its own before it
can land.

packageRules.description: A GitHub Action, looked up through github-tags, or Node, through node-version, waits three days before it is offered, as config:best-practices already has an npm release wait. Without this, either was offered the day it was published.
